title: Bankruptcy automatic stay - basics
facts: Filing a bankruptcy petition generally triggers an automatic stay that stops many collection actions against the debtor or the debtor's property.
The automatic stay can stop or pause many lawsuits, garnishments, collection calls and certain foreclosure actions, but statutory exceptions apply.
Prior bankruptcy filings, motions for relief from stay, certain domestic-support matters, criminal proceedings and other circumstances can change the stay's scope or duration.
The automatic stay is not the same as a discharge; the stay is generally temporary protection while the case proceeds.
